d: Why are regional parties increasingly reluctant to accommodate the Congress? In Uttar Pradesh, tensions over seat-sharing between the Congress and Samajwadi Party have raised questions about the future of their alliance. With Congress struggling to regain its political footprint in the state, could the growing differences between the two parties benefit the BJP? Meanwhile, what does the emerging political equation between Asaduddin Owaisi and Chandrashekhar Azad mean for UP politics? The Indian Express' Shyamlal Yadav decodes the changing dynamics of Uttar Pradesh Politics. Watch
